title: Colonal Slimey Items
description: Add Pink Slime to Golden Items!
body:
The Colonal Slimey Items Resource Pack adds Colonals signature Pink Slime to all Golden Items!

It is themed around Colonal's love of Pink Slime, and optimized for to be used in the [Colonal Mod Pack (CMP)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/colonal-pack).
